title: bot.ability.hearing.voice.detection.output
description:
Private apply result: clip-local voice spans from the voice-activity classifier (not a public product).

Empty ``segments`` means no voice in this clip. Used only to decide Start/End boundaries.
Downstream turn assembly may still receive segment lists via Listening products, not this event.

id.description: The requester's id, echoed when the answer is the long-lived stage's reply to a request [floppy field].
id.title: Id

sound.description: The sound as normalized: a WAV container's PCM, or the sound unchanged [floppy field].

audio.description: Reference (a URI reference) to the audio this stimulus carries; floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes [floppy field].
audio.title: Audio

media_type.description: Optional media type or codec label, such as audio/pcm or audio/opus.
media_type.title: Media Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Optional sample rate for raw or decoded audio, measured in hertz.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

channels.description: Optional number of audio channels represented by the chunk.
channels.title: Channels

sound.title: Sound

segments.description: Voice spans in the inspected audio, ordered by ascending start_seconds. Empty means no voice.

items.description: One voice span in the inspected audio, measured from the start of that input.

start_seconds.description: Inclusive start of this voice span, in seconds from the beginning of the inspected audio input.
start_seconds.title: Start Seconds

end_seconds.description: Exclusive end of this voice span, in seconds from the beginning of the inspected audio input.
end_seconds.title: End Seconds

confidence.description: Optional provider confidence for this span, normalized from 0.0 to 1.0 when available.
confidence.title: Confidence

items.title: VoiceDetectionSegment

segments.title: Segments
